executive_request: Generate candidate response strategies for the AWS Free Tier Integration & Strands Decider Engineering Oracle RFP and cross-vote them through the full Oracle Method cycle. The RFP's open items are the response surface: the collection contract (ITEMS-003), the baseline/fixtures (ITEMS-005), the model panel (ITEMS-006, blocked), the deployment (ITEMS-007, blocked), and the experiment order (EXPERIMENT-MATRIX E-01..E-10). Everything built in this pass is offline and in-repo; the AWS deployment and any provider panel stay specified_not_run under the card rule and DELPHI_LLM_MAX=0.
surface: AWS Free Tier Integration & Strands Decider Engineering Oracle RFP
title: Response strategy for the AWS Strands Delphi Oracle RFP

variants.concept: Extend the merged offline kernel along the matrix's recommended experiment order
variants.executive_request: Make the kernel's own experiments executable pass suites (E-05, E-01, E-03) against the frozen cohort, and publish their receipts as the RFP's first implementation evidence. Nothing else moves: the panel and the deployment stay blocked, recorded specified_not_run.

items.evidence: exit: the three suites run green in the pass record
items.item: Implement E-05/E-01/E-03 as executable suites over the frozen fixture cohort (kernel_experiments.py)

items.evidence: exit: receipts committed in the pass record with fixture hash pinned
items.item: Publish experiment receipts from the kernel's common rubric

items.evidence: exit: pass record cites the exact head the suites ran on
items.item: Carry ITEMS-005 toward done on exact-SHA evidence

summary_points.text: The deterministic baseline and frozen fixture corpus already exist and are merged (ITEMS-005 in review), and the kernel's receipt already reports E-01/E-03/E-05 metrics on that cohort.
The experiment matrix names E-05, E-01, E-03 as the recommended first three, all offline-runnable.
This strategy closes the kernel side only: the model panel (ITEMS-006) and the deployment (ITEMS-007) stay blocked and are recorded specified_not_run.

variants.concept: Build the DEBATE collection plane so the panel becomes executable when entitlement lands
variants.executive_request: Build the ballot collection plane (ITEMS-003) as working code: DEBATE-conformant intake, validation, deduplication, and class-separated collection receipts, proven by the E-06 reconstruction property. Model voting itself stays disabled.

items.evidence: exit: collector suites green; invalid and duplicate ballots refused in tests
items.item: Build ballot_collector: intake validation + dedupe + per-class receipts
Prove E-06: tallies reconstructable from the collection receipt alone

items.evidence: exit: conformance tests cite DEBATE.md sections
items.item: DEBATE conformance coverage (classes, run records, dedupe keys)

summary_points.text: The collection contract (ITEMS-003) is defined in DEBATE.md — source classes, normalized envelope, workflow states — but no collector exists; intake is the missing piece.
A collector built now makes ITEMS-006 executable the moment a no-cost entitlement is validated, without enabling model voting today.
E-06 is its natural first test: tallies must be reconstructable from the collection receipt alone.

variants.concept: Generalize the D0 Lambda packaging as the deployment shape, up to the account gate
variants.executive_request: Treat the completed D0 packaging as the RFP's deployment shape: prove handler conformance, simulate the E-08 budget circuit breaker offline, and audit the package's no-deployment claims. The deployment step itself (ITEMS-007) stays specified_not_run under the card rule.

items.evidence: exit: conformance suite green against the shipped handler
items.item: Handler conformance suite over the D0 packaging (ABSTAIN/ESCALATE, zero external calls)

items.evidence: exit: breaker suite green; overshoot 0 by construction
exit: audit suite green over the demo receipts
items.item: No-deploy-claim audit across the package receipts

summary_points.text: A working Lambda-shaped packaging of this oracle already exists and is completed (D0): handler, agent, evidence tool, demo receipts — with deployment claimed nowhere.
E-08 is simulable offline before any account exists, per the experiment matrix.
The deployment step itself (ITEMS-007) stays specified_not_run under the card rule; this strategy builds everything up to that gate and nothing past it.
